context: Servicing a captive mechanical coupling requires following its spring-loaded internal release track through multiple axial levels and a rotational reversal before extracting the sleeve. This custom unpowered fixture tests constrained disassembly and recovery of the loose part.
fidelity: Custom rigid primitive two-pin multistage bore track; original dimensions, clearances and release stages retained. Seed42 spring308.9N/m,1.5Ns/m damping; estimated material/contact values, no fracture or plasticity. YAM uses actual27/7Nm total gravity-inclusive arms and40N fingers. See FIDELITY.md.
instruction: Take the purple sleeve with three white bars off its fixed shaft and put it in the green tray. Leave the shaft clear and the sleeve resting wholly inside the tray without robot contact for20seconds.
reset_notes: SDK reset restores seated sleeve and plunger preload15mm, both arms READY/open; settling earns no hold. No consumables.
run_limit: 6,000 control steps at 20 Hz (300 simulated seconds).
